## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what the user sees after this change.

## Related issue

Link the issue, if available.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. For a bug fix, include the regression test's observed failing and passing results. Note any checks blocked by the environment or an unrelated failure.

## QA notes

Include steps to verify the change, relevant screenshots, and any effect on saved URLs, browser storage, exports, or template defaults. For responsibility changes, link authoritative sources.

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated behavior.
- [ ] A regression test exercises the reported bug, where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant lint, type, test, and build checks pass, or limitations are documented above.
- [ ] UI content snapshots and layout checks pass; styling changes have been reviewed manually.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed commands or behavior.
- [ ] Examples and screenshots contain no real client data or credentials.
